title: Pre-Registered Predictions for the Energy-Flow Cosmology Model Against the Rubin Observatory LSST DP2 Cosmic Shear Dataset
abstract: This pre-registration seals quantitative, falsifiable predictions of the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) model for Rubin Observatory LSST Data Preview 2 (DP2) cosmic shear. It forecasts an ~8–10% large-scale lensing enhancement and S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015 driven by a gravitational slip η ≈ 1.10, and specifies explicit falsification thresholds against the forthcoming DP2 measurements.
